sections.question: EOG's total debt at June 30, 2026 was what percentage of its total debt at the end of 2019? Round to one decimal place.
sections.reasoning:
1. Doc 1 (March 16, 2020): at December 31, 2019 the net debt reconciliation shows "Current and Long-Term Debt (GAAP) - (b)" of 5,175 million; the release text rounds this total debt to "$5.2 billion".
2. Doc 7: the same line at June 30, 2026 is 7,926 million, and 7,926 / 5,175 = 153.2% (to one decimal place).
